parts.title: Revised P1 QJ main/subfeed breaker kit, 1-phase 2/3-wire

description.value: Main/subfeed breaker kit for QJ2, QJH2 and QJ2-H breakers in Revised P1 panelboards, 1-phase 2/3-wire; breaker purchased separately

application.value: Main or subfeed in panels rated 250 A or less; subfeed ONLY in panels above 250 A (P1-400)

breaker_compat.value: QJ2, QJH2, QJ2-H

kit_contents.value: 1 breaker barrier assembly; 1 breaker escutcheon; 1 MAIN label; 1 neutral lug assembly; 1/4-20x1/2 hex head SEMS assembly screws (2 for 1-ph, 3 for 3-ph) to phase bus; 4x #10-24x1/2 slotted hex washer thread-forming screws (barrier to base rails); 1/4-20x1/2 hex head SEMS (2/3) breaker to straps; 1x 1/4-20 belleville washer nut; 2x 1/4-20x3-1/4 slotted round head screws (breaker to barrier). Breaker NOT included.

torque.value: 1/4-20 SEMS to phase bus 72 lb-in; #10-24 thread-forming to base rails 30 lb-in; 1/4-20 SEMS breaker-to-strap 72 lb-in; 1/4-20 belleville nut (neutral) 72 lb-in; 1/4-20x3-1/4 round head breaker-to-barrier 20 lb-in max. Tighten order: base rails, phase bus, breaker straps.

fasteners.value: 1/4-20x1/2 hex SEMS; #10-24x1/2 slotted hex washer thread-forming; 1/4-20 belleville washer nut; 1/4-20x3-1/4 slotted round head

id_features.value: Revised P1 interior part number ends in 'N' or 'T' (e.g. P1E42MC250AT); kit will not fit Original P1

location.value: Main end of panel (main) or feed-thru/subfeed end (subfeed); neutral lug assembly mounted below neutral cross bus
